Andhra Pradesh Deputy CM and Ministers Skip Cabinet Meeting

Andhra Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Pawan Kalyan and two ministers from his Jana Sena Party did not attend a state cabinet meeting. The meeting was scheduled to discuss the quota for Backward Classes (BC). Pawan Kalyan also recently highlighted the sacrifices of Jana Sena cadres in the lead-up to local body polls.
